result.rationale: The diff introduces EmbeddableHost with only a format validation (app/models/embeddable_host.rb: validates_format_of :host ...) and no uniqueness validation; the migration creates the table without a unique index on host; and record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host).first with no ORDER BY. TopicEmbed.import then uses eh.try(:category_id) for the topic's category. Duplicate rows would cause nondeterministic category assignment on embed import — a real correctness defect in the new behavior (the old site-setting-based approach could not have duplicate hosts).
